values: 热爱魔物的冒险者，能够从魔物身上收集食材并烹饪料理，从而为友军提供多种增益。
An adventurer who loves monsters. He's able to collect ingredients from them and cook meals to provide buffs to allies.
Now, we can move ahead together.
就用好久没玩的那招吧
It's been a while, but I'll try that thing.
各位平时都吃魔物的吗？
Do you regularly eat monsters too?
真可爱 给你起个名字吧
You cute thing! Let me give you a name.
到底会是什么味道的呢
I wonder what they taste like.
莱欧斯会画画，但只擅长画魔物，画其他的东西就不行了。
Laios is good at drawing monsters, but not much else.
莱欧斯本想成为一个魔物研究者，却因为需要学习的知识太多而放弃了。
Laios once wanted to become a monster researcher, but gave up when he realized how much he'd have to learn.
莱欧斯似乎具备一定的魔法天赋。在玛露西尔的教导下，他掌握了治疗魔法等简单的魔法。
Turns out Laios has a bit of magical talent, after all. Marcille taught him some basic spells, including healing.
莱欧斯虽然对魔物很感兴趣，但面对危险魔物他也从不掉以轻心。
Laios is fascinated by monsters, but he never underestimates how dangerous some of them can be.
莱欧斯曾为了填饱肚子而进入画中饱餐一顿，可惜出来后又恢复了饥肠辘辘的状态。
Laios once ate a feast inside a painting, but came out just as hungry as before.
莱欧斯从未吃过章鱼和鱿鱼，当他遇见跟它们相似的克拉肯时，却因生食其寄生虫而导致严重食物中毒。
Laios never ate squid or octopus growing up. In the dungeon, when he tried something similar—kraken—he got severe food poisoning from the parasites.
莱欧斯过去因为差点和队员恋爱而导致小队濒临解散危机，从此他被禁止职场恋爱。
In the past, Laios nearly fell in love with a party member, which nearly led to the party breaking up. Since then, he's been banned from workplace romance.
莱欧斯的佩剑名为剑助，它能感知周围的魔物，但遇到危险的魔物时可能会自行逃跑。
Laios' sword, Kensuke, can sense nearby monsters, but it might try to flee from anything too dangerous.
在尝过蛇尾鸡和毒蛇鸡后，莱欧斯终于开始怀疑——《迷宫美食指南》的作者可能并没有亲口尝过多少魔物。
After trying cockatrice and basilisk, Laios started to wonder if the author of the Dungeon Gourmet Guide had ever actually eaten any monsters.
莱欧斯从记事起就和很多猎犬一起长大，并从它们身上学到了不少东西。他学狗叫的本领尤为出色。
Laios grew up surrounded by hunting dogs and learned a lot from them. He's especially good at imitating their barks.
